A Beginner’s Guide to Covering the Sex Industry
Sex work seems to be everywhere these days. Storylines about sex workers have popped up in shows like
Euphoria
,
Margo’s Got Money Troubles
, and
Hacks
. Yet even as OnlyFans has become a household name, few journalists actually understand the inner workings of this often underground industry — or how to build trust that’s needed to get sex worker sources to open up about these stories.
In this
course
, Lux Alptraum, an adult industry expert and one-time editor of the porn blog Fleshbot, will walk you through the basics of reporting on the sex industry. In addition to providing an overview of the different corners of the sex industry, she’ll also explain why so many sex workers do not trust journalists, and walk participants through the best practices for covering adult industry-related topics.
The 1.5 hour course will take place August 14th at 10 AM PDT/ 1 PM ET.

For
Playgirl
, Jill Rittenberg interviewed romance novelists about their work. Rittenberg told Study Hall: "I dug into the craft of writing sex and why it matters to storytelling. Authors Alicia Thompson, Lana Ferguson, Allie Oleander, and Isabelle Popp gave me their thoughts on the craft."
Nana Asfour Wrote About Her Childhood In Lebanon
For
McSweeney's
, Nana Asfour reflected on growing up during Lebanon's brutal civil war. Asfour told
Study Hall
: "In a hybrid first-person narrative and reporting essay for McSweeney’s new non-fiction section, I wrote about war, childhood friendships, shelters and giant tweezers."
Topacio "Topaz" Servellon Wrote About The Impact of Expanding The DeConcini Border Crossing
For
Tucson Spotlight
, Topacio "Topaz" Servellon reported on how "a federal proposal to expand the DeConcini border crossing would demolish a historic Nogales neighborhood." Servellon told
Study Hall
:"No one really talks about the mental health toll that comes with covering the border and immigration. I fell into a deep depression for two weeks. Then I dragged myself to a public meeting about a border port expansion, a city over. I wrote the story anyway. And when I finished it? I was proud. Really proud, actually! Turns out I can still do my job, even after a funk. Reminder for all journalists out there: Taking time away doesn't make you any less of a journalist."
Karli Poliziani Wrote A Travel Guide To Saint-Tropez
For
Condé Nast Traveler
, Karli Poliziani wrote about "the best places to eat, stay, and drink rosé in Saint-Tropez for Summer 2026, before the debut of the highly anticipated
The White Lotus
season 4—set to make Saint-Tropez an even buzzier hotspot for the Euro summer crowd."
